description: This file defines a REST controller for managing driver-related HTTP API endpoints within the NeuroFleetX backend. It includes endpoints to retrieve all drivers and individual driver details by ID, utilizing the DriverService.

classes.name: DriverController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller responsible for handling driver-related API requests. It provides endpoints to fetch all drivers or a specific driver by ID.

methods.name: getAllDrivers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all drivers.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific driver by ID.
